features.name: x1_centered_score
features.description: Training-fold centered and scaled x1, clipped to reduce extreme leverage while retaining sign and relative magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded, comparable x1 coordinate so the linear margin can assign stable weight without scale dominance.

features.name: x2_centered_score
features.description: Training-fold centered and scaled x2, clipped to reduce extreme leverage while retaining sign and relative magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places the below-zero x2 scale on a standardized axis, improving conditioning for a linear margin.

features.name: x4_centered_score
features.description: Training-fold centered and scaled x4, clipped to reduce extreme leverage while retaining sign and relative magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the shifted x4 interval into a compact coordinate suited to a stable linear margin.

features.name: x5_centered_score
features.description: Training-fold centered and scaled x5, using a slightly tighter clip because the observed range is naturally compact.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a smooth signed coordinate for the compact x5 range without letting it vanish beside larger-scale fields.

features.name: x6_centered_score
features.description: Training-fold centered and scaled x6 with clipping to control the widest numeric spread in the table.
features.expected_model_benefit: Stabilizes the high-variance x6 coordinate so a linear margin can use it without excessive leverage.

features.name: x9_centered_score
features.description: Training-fold centered and scaled x9, clipped to a bounded standardized interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Makes the broad x9 range comparable to other coordinates for better linear weight conditioning.

features.name: x10_centered_score
features.description: Training-fold centered and scaled x10, clipped to a bounded standardized interval.
features.expected_model_benefit: Puts x10 on the same numeric scale as other continuous inputs, supporting stable margin geometry.

features.name: x9_x10_ratio_score
features.description: Centered ratio of x9 to x10 using the training-fold typical ratio as the reference point.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets one weight capture proportional movement between x9 and x10 beyond their separate standardized coordinates.

features.name: numeric_elevation_projection
features.description: Unsupervised weighted sum of centered numeric coordinates, clipped for robustness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a compact composite direction that can help when several numeric coordinates shift together.

features.name: x7_yes_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator that x7 has the value yes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows an exact numeric axis for the x7 yes/no field, avoiding reliance on raw text handling.

features.name: x3_color_warmth_score
features.description: Semantic score for x3 hue: red maps to 1.0, brown maps to 0.55, green maps to 0.15, and any unexpected value maps to 0.50.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts hue meaning into an ordered continuous coordinate that a linear margin can use directly.

features.name: x8_size_extent_score
features.description: Semantic size score from x8 wording: normal maps to 0.0, large maps to 1.0, and any unexpected value maps to 0.50.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes size wording as monotone severity, giving the margin a simple ordinal scale.
